title: Bowing
translation: Glory to my Lord, the Mighty.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 772: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/1743

usage.evidence: Hudhayfah prayed with the Prophet ﷺ at night and heard him say this in his bowing (Muslim 772). The count of three comes in a narration of Ibn Mas'ud whose chain al-Tirmidhi says is not connected, so no count is given here.
